ideas.title: Orbit Hop
ideas.pitch: Tap to leap between spinning planets. Dead-center landings chain combos; skipping planets pays extra.

ideas.title: Pixel Hoops
ideas.pitch: 3-on-3 pixel basketball: tap to run, slingshot passes, a timing meter for every shot, and timed steals and blocks. Season mode with upgrades.

ideas.title: Flip Run
ideas.pitch: Endless runner where a tap flips gravity between floor and ceiling. Gaps on one side, spikes on the other.

ideas.title: Pipe Bloom
ideas.pitch: Rotate pipe tiles to route water to every flower. A fresh seeded puzzle every day, with a streak counter.

ideas.title: Merge Forge
ideas.pitch: Merge ore into ingots into tools — and tools are used up to smash blocked tiles. Merging with a crafting twist.

ideas.title: Dice Delve
ideas.pitch: Five-minute runs: roll dice and slot them into attack, shield or heal. Pick a dice upgrade between each floor.

ideas.title: Pocket Deck
ideas.pitch: A tiny deckbuilder: 3 acts, 12-card decks and relics that bend the rules. Built for one-thumb play.

ideas.title: Hex Claim
ideas.pitch: 2–4 players take turns claiming hexes. Fully enclose a region and every hex inside flips to you.

ideas.title: Sketch Relay
ideas.pitch: Drawing telephone: draw the prompt, pass the phone, the next player guesses, and so on — then watch the reveal reel.

ideas.title: Deep Delve
ideas.pitch: Turn-based dungeon crawl: 4 classes, unidentified potions and scrolls, procedural floors, saved every turn, and unlocks between runs.

ideas.title: Drift Fleet
ideas.pitch: Cross a sector map in a fragile ship: hire crew, trade cargo, survive events, upgrade systems. 1–2 hour runs, save anywhere.

ideas.title: Echo Maze
ideas.pitch: Your echo repeats every move you made three turns ago. Both of you must reach an exit at the same time.

ideas.title: Slingshot Links
ideas.pitch: One-shot mini golf in space: drag to aim, and gravity wells curve the ball around asteroids into the cup.

ideas.title: Lantern Keeper
ideas.pitch: Keep five lanterns lit through the night. Moths swarm the brightest one, so tap to shoo them and drag to refuel.

ideas.title: Sum Serpent
ideas.pitch: A snake that eats numbers. Hit the target sum exactly to shed your tail; overshoot and you grow.

ideas.title: Tide Tiles
ideas.pitch: Swipe whole rows like waves. Shells that line up wash away; the tide rises every 10 moves.

ideas.title: Ink Cartographer
ideas.pitch: Draw your route through a fog-covered map with limited ink. Whatever you pass reveals loot or danger.

ideas.title: Clockwork Siege
ideas.pitch: Ten-wave tower defense where you draft tower parts between waves and gears combine into odd hybrids.

ideas.title: Rune Hollow
ideas.pitch: A roguelike where you craft spells from three runes: shape, element, twist. 'Chain-Frost-Echo' is a different spell every run.

ideas.title: Abyss Angler
ideas.pitch: Fish deeper each dive, sell the catch, upgrade your boat. The deep has stranger things — and a lighthouse to restore.

ideas.title: Hearth & Harvest
ideas.pitch: Seasonal village builder in turns: plan crops, weather events, and a hard winter at the end of each year. Multi-year saves.

ideas.title: Heist Hands
ideas.pitch: Secret-role bluffing for 3–6 players. Each player privately peeks at their role, then the crew votes on who carries the loot.

ideas.title: Thumb Duel
ideas.pitch: Two players hold opposite ends of the phone. Reflex mini-duels: quick draw, tug of war, don't-blink.

ideas.title: Shadow Tag
ideas.pitch: Hot-seat hide and seek on a fogged grid. The hider plans moves in secret; the seekers get footprints.

ideas.title: Paper Glider
ideas.pitch: Hold to climb, release to glide. Ride updrafts through a paper city that folds up as you pass.

ideas.title: Gem Rivers
ideas.pitch: A daily 60-second puzzle: drag to dig channels so colored rivers carry gems to matching pools.
